verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Plaid IDV exposes a documented API (e.g. /identity_verification/retry) and a client-side integration via Link with callbacks (onEvent, onSuccess), implying SDK-like tooling, but there is no explicit evidence pack mention of official language SDKs (Node/Python/Java/etc.) or a discoverable OpenAPI spec — the openapi.json probe returned 404s. missing for 10: explicit multi-language SDK documentation, publicly discoverable OpenAPI/schema, independent developer confirmation of SDK usage.
